description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to test prioritization heuristics in a testing framework, including the TestPrioritizations class for managing test rankings, the AggregatedHeuristics class for combining multiple heuristics, and the HeuristicInterface for implementing specific heuristics.

classes.name: TestPrioritizations
classes.description: Manages prioritized lists of tests with scoring, validation, and serialization functionalities.

classes.name: AggregatedHeuristics
classes.description: Combines results from multiple heuristics to produce an aggregated test prioritization.

classes.name: HeuristicInterface
classes.description: Defines the interface that all heuristic classes must implement, including a method for predicting test confidence scores.

methods.name: None validate(self)
methods.description: Validates the internal consistency of test sets and scores within TestPrioritizations.

methods.name: None set_test_score(self, test_run: TestRun, new_score: float)
methods.description: Sets or updates the score for a given test run, affecting related tests in the prioritization.

methods.name: None add_test_score(self, test_run: TestRun, score_to_add: float)
methods.description: Adds a score increment to relevant test runs based on overlaps.

methods.name: list[TestRun] get_all_tests(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all test runs in the prioritization.

methods.name: tuple[list[TestRun],list[TestRun]] get_top_per_tests(self, n: int)
methods.description: Divides tests into top and remaining based on a percentage threshold.

methods.name: str get_info_str(self, verbose: bool = True)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of test scores, optionally verbose.

methods.name: None print_info(self)
methods.description: Prints the test prioritization information.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_priority_info_for_test(self, test_run: TestRun)
methods.description: Provides prioritization details for a specific test run.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_test_stats(self, test: TestRun)
methods.description: Returns statistics for a particular test run.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] to_json(self)
methods.description: Serializes the TestPrioritizations object to a JSON-compatible dictionary.

methods.name: TestPrioritizations from_json(json_dict: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON dictionary to reconstruct a TestPrioritizations object.

methods.name: None amend_tests(self, tests: list[str])
methods.description: Refines the set of tests to a specified list, updating scores and validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the internal consistency of the heuristics' results in AggregatedHeuristics.

methods.name: None add_heuristic_results( self, heuristic: HeuristicInterface, heuristic_results: TestPrioritizations )
methods.description: Adds heuristic results to the aggregation, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: TestPrioritizations get_aggregated_priorities( self, include_trial: bool = False )
methods.description: Returns an aggregated test prioritization from all heuristics.

methods.name: get_test_stats
methods.description: Provides combined heuristic metrics and aggregated prioritization info for a specific test.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the aggregated heuristics to a JSON dictionary.

methods.description: Returns the name of the heuristic for string representation.

methods.description: Abstract method that must return a TestPrioritizations object with confidence scores for tests.
